title: 第10章 骷髅士兵
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
“熟了的骨头…… 应该也能用吧？”

    林奇盯着盆里刚捞出来的骨头，热气腾腾的水汽模糊了他的视线，骨头上还沾着些许肉沫，散发着浓郁的骨汤香味。

    他咬了咬牙，眼底闪过一丝狠劲：“赌了！就算失败，大不了再等老爹买新鲜骨头回来！”

    林奇抬手一扬，灰白的骨头本命卡凭空出现，轻飘飘地落入凉水盆中。

    接着，他又掏出那张漩涡规则卡，指尖微微颤抖着捏紧卡牌。

    “天老爷啊，这次一定要让我成功，回头我给您摆上最好的贡品，再烧三炷香！”

    林奇一边念叨着，一边将源力注入卡内。

    下一秒，一道漩涡突然在盆中出现，旋转的气流带着细微的呼啸声，将盆里的骨头尽数卷入其中。

    林奇屏住呼吸，眼睛一眨不眨地盯着漩涡，心脏跳得飞快。

    不过一个呼吸的功夫，漩涡骤然消失，盆里的骨头没了踪影，只剩下一张卡牌静静躺在盆底。

    “成了！”

    林奇激动得声音都在发颤，他伸手将卡牌捞出来，指尖的触感冰凉又熟悉。

    卡牌正面画着一个模样古怪的骷髅。

    比莱芙留下的骷髅小兵矮了一大截，也就一米不到，骨头缝里还隐约能看到煮过的痕迹，看起来松松垮垮的。

    召唤卡，骷髅小兵

    评价：一个骨质疏松且东拼西凑的骷髅，勉强算是一个炮灰与素材

    脑海中浮现出这个信息，林奇一时间是又想哭又想笑。

    这结果算不上完美，可总归是他亲手融合出的第一张卡牌！

    “召唤，骷髅小兵！”

    将源力注入卡牌。

    没有耀眼的光芒，只有一道淡淡的灰雾闪过。

    紧接着，一个矮墩墩的骷髅就出现在他面前。

    这骷髅摇摇晃晃地站着，每动一下，骨头就发出“咯吱咯吱”的响声，像是下一秒就要散架。

    “哈哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈。”

    林奇再也忍不住，放声大笑起来。

    这些日子里觉醒废卡的憋屈、被人嘲笑的难堪、修炼无果的焦虑，全都随着这笑声烟消云散。

    他伸手想去拍拍骷髅小兵的肩膀，可指尖刚碰到骨头，那骷髅“哗啦”一声就散了架，骨头滚得满地都是。

    “呃……”

    林奇的笑声戛然而止，看着地上的骨头堆，无奈地摇摇头。

    “这么脆弱，怪不得本命卡还是没颜色。”

    他挥手收回骷髅，目光落在了莱芙留下的那张一星召唤卡骷髅小兵上。

    “既然熟骨头能融合出基础款，那两张骷髅卡应该能再进化吧？”

    他迫不及待地将两张骷髅卡和规则卡握在手里，源力再次注入。

    规则卡悬浮在空中，卡面上的漩涡飞速转动，将两张骷髅卡一并吸了进去。

    一秒、两秒、三秒……

    漩涡停下的瞬间，一张泛着白色光芒的卡牌缓缓落下。

    就在这张卡牌出现的刹那，林奇的意识深处突然传来“嗡”的一声，像是有什么东西被打开了。

    一个半透明的空间在他脑海里浮现，里面能清晰地看到卡槽的轮廓！

    “卡槽空间！我突破一星卡徒了！”

    林奇激动得跳了起来，手里的卡牌仿佛有了生命，源源不断的信息涌入他的脑海。

    召唤卡，骷髅士兵。
content_en:
"Cooked bones... should be able to be used, right?"

    Lin Qi stared at the bones that had just been taken out of the basin. The steaming water vapor blurred his vision. There was still some minced meat on the bones, exuding a strong aroma of bone soup.

    He gritted his teeth, and a trace of fierceness flashed in his eyes: "It's a gamble! Even if you fail, the worst thing you can do is wait until dad comes back to buy fresh bones!"

    Lin Qi raised his hand, and the gray bone life card appeared out of thin air and fell lightly into the cold water basin.

    Then, he took out the whirlpool rule card and squeezed the card tightly with his fingertips trembling slightly.

    "God, please let me succeed this time. I will give you the best tribute and burn three sticks of incense later!"

    Lin Qi was chanting while injecting source power into the card.

    The next second, a vortex suddenly appeared in the basin, and the rotating air flow carried a subtle whistling sound, sucking all the bones in the basin into it.

    Lin Qi held his breath and stared at the vortex without blinking, his heart beating rapidly.

    In just one breath, the vortex suddenly disappeared, the bones in the basin disappeared, and only a card was left lying quietly on the bottom of the basin.

    "It's done!"

    Lynch's voice was trembling with excitement. He stretched out his hand to fish out the card, and the touch of his fingertips was cold and familiar.

    There is a strange-looking skull painted on the front of the card.

    It was a lot shorter than the skeleton soldier left by Leif, only less than one meter. There were still faint traces of cooking in the bones, and they looked loose.

    Summon card, skeleton minion

    Evaluation: An osteoporotic and patchwork skeleton can barely be regarded as cannon fodder and material.

    This information came to mind, and Lynch wanted to cry and laugh at the same time.

    This result is not perfect, but it is still the first card he has fused with his own hands!

    "Summon, Skeleton Soldier!"

    Inject source power into the card.

    There was no dazzling light, only a faint gray mist flashed by.

    Immediately afterwards, a short skeleton appeared in front of him.

    The skeleton stood staggeringly, and every time it moved, the bones made a "creaking" sound, as if it would fall apart in the next second.

    "Hahahaha, hahahaha."

    Lynch couldn't hold it in any longer and burst out laughing.

    The frustration of awakening the useless card these days, the embarrassment of being laughed at, and the anxiety of fruitless cultivation all disappeared with this laughter.

    He reached out to pat the skeleton soldier on the shoulder, but as soon as his fingertips touched the bones, the skeleton fell apart with a "crash" and the bones rolled all over the floor.

    "Uh..."

    Lin Qi's laughter stopped suddenly. He looked at the pile of bones on the ground and shook his head helplessly.

    "It's so fragile, no wonder the natal card still has no color."

    He waved his hand to take back the skeleton, and his eyes fell on the one-star summoning card skeleton minion left by Leif.

    "Since cooked bones can be fused to create the basic version, then the two skeleton cards should be able to evolve, right?"

    He couldn't wait to hold the two skull cards and the rule card in his hands, and injected his source power again.

    The rule card was suspended in the air, and the vortex on the card surface rotated rapidly, sucking in the two skull cards together.

    One second, two seconds, three seconds...

    The moment the vortex stopped, a card glowing with white light slowly fell down.

    The moment this card appeared, a "buzz" sound suddenly came from the depths of Lynch's consciousness, as if something had been opened.

    A translucent space emerged in his mind, and the outline of the card slot could be clearly seen inside!

    "Card slot space! I have broken through the one-star card disciple!"

    Lynch jumped with excitement. The cards in his hand seemed to have come to life, and a steady stream of information poured into his mind.

    Summon card, skeleton soldier.
